title: Paid-Month Value Credited on a Professional Email Annual Conversion
content:
Billing standard. The paid-month value of a Professional Email annual conversion is read from the charges of the current term. The charge that opened the current term is the new-subscription or renewal charge whose period start is the term start date; an added-seat or upgrade line never opens a term.

1. Where a charge opened the current term and no added-seat line whose period end is the term end date belongs to the term, the paid-month value is that charge's amount.
2. Where a charge opened the current term and such added-seat lines belong to the term, it is that charge's amount plus the amounts of those lines.
3. Otherwise, where no charge on record opened the current term, it is the product's month-to-month seat price times the converted seats.

Examples (hypothetical lines):
- a renewal charge of 118.60 opening the month, no added-seat line: 118.60;
- the same renewal charge and an added-seat line of 21.40 ending on the term end date: 140.00;
- no opening charge on record, 26 seats at a hypothetical month-to-month price of 12.00: 312.00.
